options.name: credentials_file
options.description: path to the JSON file associated with the service account email

options.name: external_ip
options.description: the external static IPv4 (or auto-assigned) address for the LB

options.name: httphealthcheck_healthy_count
options.description: number of consecutive successful checks before marking a node healthy

options.name: httphealthcheck_host
options.description: host header to pass through on HTTP check requests

options.name: httphealthcheck_interval
options.description: the duration in seconds between each health check request

options.name: httphealthcheck_name
options.description: the name identifier for the HTTP health check

options.name: httphealthcheck_path
options.description: the url path to use for HTTP health checking

options.name: httphealthcheck_port
options.description: the TCP port to use for HTTP health checking

options.name: httphealthcheck_timeout
options.description: the timeout in seconds before a request is considered a failed check

options.name: httphealthcheck_unhealthy_count
options.description: number of consecutive failed checks before marking a node unhealthy

options.name: members
options.description: a list of zone/nodename pairs, e.g ['us-central1-a/www-a', ...]

options.name: pem_file
options.description: path to the pem file associated with the service account email This option is deprecated. Use 'credentials_file'.

options.name: port_range
options.description: the port (range) to forward, e.g. 80 or 8000-8888 defaults to all ports

options.name: protocol
options.description: the protocol used for the load-balancer packet forwarding, tcp or udp the available choices are: C(tcp) or C(udp).

options.name: region
options.description: the GCE region where the load-balancer is defined

options.name: state
options.description: desired state of the LB the available choices are: C(active), C(present), C(absent), C(deleted).
